entries.text: Summary Bump React DevTools from 7.0.1 to 8.0.0 (packages + extension manifests only; no publish). scripts/devtools/prepare-release.js only supports minor/patch, so this major bump is manual. Changelog is curated from DevTools commits since 7.0.1 (features vs bugfixes; internal/test-only changes omitted). Test plan Confirm published package versions would be 8.0.0 for react-devtools, react-devtools-core, and react-devtools-inline Confirm Chrome/Edge/Firefox extension manifests show 8.0.0 Review packages/react-devtools/CHANGELOG.md 8.0.0 section for accuracy before undrafting
